description: This PHP source file defines the DetailedPerformanceReviewModel class used in the OrangeHRM performance plugin to represent detailed information about performance reviews, including serialization and mapping of review data.

classes.name: DetailedPerformanceReviewModel
classes.description: A model class for representing detailed performance review data with serialization logic and associations to performance review entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a PerformanceReview entity and sets filters and attribute mappings for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model to an array, including fetching the self-review status via the performance review service.
